FuncVI Development

Owning Palette: CalcExpress

This palette contains VIs to be used for developing FuncVIs (CalcExpress functions implemented as VIs).

 

Palette Object Description
Exp - Error handler.vi Use this VI to declare custom CalcExpress errors in FuncVIs.
Exp - Get CalcExpress Error as Error Cluster.vi Use this VI to retrieve a CalcExpress error as the standard LabVIEW error cluster.
Exp - Get VC Handle.vi Returns the VC Handle and the writer ID associated with the running CalcExpress instance.
Func - Error Status to Error Cluster.vi Converts a Boolean error status to the standard error cluster.
Func - Get argument.vi Returns the value of the specified function argument. It verifies the total number of actual arguments but does not check argument data types.
Func - Get DBL argument as 1D Array.vi Returns the value of a function argument transformed into 1D array of DBL values. The requested argument must be a DBL scalar, or a 1D or 2D array thereof.
Func - Get declared arguments.vi Returns the values of function arguments. It verifies the number of actual arguments and their data types according to provided declaration.
Func - get function name_.vi Returns the name of the FuncVI and the name of its function when it is called within a FuncVI hierarchy.
Func - Get list of arguments.vi Returns the values of function arguments. It verifies the number of actual arguments but does not check argument data types.
Func - Get list of numeric arguments.vi Returns the values of function arguments which must all have the DBL Number data type. It verifies the number of actual arguments and their data types.
Func - Get list of string arguments.vi Returns the values of function arguments which must all have the String data type. It verifies the number of actual arguments and their data types.
Func - LV runtime error handler (Error Cluster).vi Handles errors returned by LabVIEW VIs and functions.
Func - LV runtime error handler_.vi Handles errors returned by LabVIEW VIs and functions.
Func - Unflatten Error Handler (Error Cluster).vi Handles an error produced by the Unflatten From String LabVIEW function.
Func - Unflatten-From-String Error handler.vi Handles an error produced by the Unflatten From String LabVIEW function.
Func - VarMan Error Handler (Error Cluster).vi Handles errors returned by VarMan VIs.
Func - VarMan Error handler.vi Handles errors returned by VarMan VIs.
Func - VarMan VI Error Cluster to Func Result Value.vi Converts an error returned by a VarMan VI to the value returned by a FuncVI function.
